aggregate_summary.metric: For each context, average across all nine k/B profiles the augmented-minus-baseline solved fraction. Empty-goal context difference is zero. Primary contrast full learned minus predeclared greedy_coverage. Report all policies/profiles and raw denominators.

automation_control.coverage: Entire retained test workload, not a showcase sample.
automation_control.interpretation: Separate stronger Mathlib automation under its fixed resource cap; goal visits are not tactic heartbeats, so no matched computational-work claim.
automation_control.method: Pointwise Set Nat membership unfolding, simp only[mem_union,mem_inter] at *, aesop; no seed/candidates

holdout.normalization: Complete positive DNF endpoint antichains and joint alpha orbit over used variables; not arbitrary semantic-substitution schema closure

formal_verification.scope: Every candidate and every distinct successful held-out proof across all policies, random repetitions and nine budget profiles. Train uses canonical greedy k3/B8 successes; validation retains learned/greedy/branching k3/B8 witnesses. Training label probes are not individually certified. Repeated candidate/library audits across chunks are not new discoveries.

limitations: Known distributive-lattice mathematics, not human mathematical originality. Same mathematical domain with structurally different generation families and recognized theorem-statement holdout. No learned superiority unless measured; no necessity inference from bounded failure. Symbolic hashes/bootstrap ridge are conventional, uncertainty is uncalibrated.

model_history.interpretation: Generated training proof use of actual registered Mathlib constants; not Mathlib chronology or human citation counts.
model_history.source: Unique successful frozen training baseline proof ASTs; deduplicated across budget profiles before counting

model_training.target: Portfolio-conditioned marginal solve fraction U(S+c)-U(S), at B4/8/12 with fixed seeded prefix sizes0..4; no test outcomes or utility-adaptive partners

protocol.choice_feasibility_gate: Before any training labels or test solve outcomes: at least 20 of fixed 24 test contexts must have retained goals and more than five candidates. Every context remains in evaluation; failure stops this experiment rather than tuning to a desired gain.
protocol.claim_limits: Known distributive-lattice mathematics, not human mathematical originality. Same mathematical domain with structurally different generation families and recognized theorem-statement holdout. No learned superiority unless measured; no necessity inference from bounded failure. Symbolic hashes/bootstrap ridge are conventional, uncertainty is uncalibrated.
protocol.cleaning: Complete positive-DNF endpoint antichains and a joint alpha-renaming key remove equality endpoints, actual finite registered closed facts, duplicate statement pairs and candidate-as-goal pairs. Prune validation against all retained training closed facts/candidates/goals, then test against training+validation. Exclude direct RAW syntactic zero-premise leaf goals. Generic inference schemas are not arbitrary semantic-substitution exclusions. Never refill from utility outcomes; retain empty contexts.
protocol.generation: Seed-dependent inclusions are weakened distributivity instances, shared-term monotonic wrappers, or binary monotonic combinations of two nontrivial seed-dependent proofs. Raw goals combine two distinct supplied candidate statements with union/intersection; reference derivations are used only to validate generation and are not supplied to selectors or bounded search.
protocol.guidance_limit: A supplied lemma also adds syntactic midpoint guidance, so benefit measures registry proof-search assistance, not only proof-node replacement.

heuristic_formulas.branching_aware: Dynamic greedy root-work score plus newly completed exact complementary child-pair groups whose parent is not already supplied. Known premises are supplied exact statement pairs plus direct raw syntactic leaves only. Closing a parent never globally proves its OR-route descendants; no arbitrary second match to a goal.
heuristic_formulas.graph: Static singleton estimated root-work decrease divided by B, plus crossing estimated cost<=B, averaged over goals.
heuristic_formulas.greedy_coverage: Recompute that root-work objective after every portfolio addition on the raw AND/OR graph. Syntactic primitive or supplied leaf cost 1; unsupplied candidate pair prior is its available proof-AST node count; other frontier/cycle prior 2+min(8,total term nodes/32); AND cost 1+both children, OR minimum. Estimates are not bounded-search outcomes.
heuristic_formulas.proof_cost: Fewest available candidate proof-AST nodes; candidate proofs already generated for every method.
heuristic_formulas.random: Five fixed repetitions, seeds 4400..4404; average repetitions within each context before summaries.
heuristic_formulas.semantic: Transparent cosine of typed raw AST syntax tokens, not pretrained semantics.

interval.unit: paired whole-context cluster over the profile-averaged primary difference

protocol.midpoint_menu: At most eight: selected-lemma boundary matches in sorted ID order; syntactic forward/backward distributivity pivots; source-meet children/target-join children; at most eight frozen context intermediates sorted by syntax size/key. Deduplicate raw syntax, exclude endpoints, reject out-of-bound terms. Every transitivity child is solved and emitted. No DNF proof closure.
protocol.primary_metric: For each context, average across all nine k/B profiles the augmented-minus-baseline solved fraction. Empty-goal context difference is zero. Primary contrast full learned minus predeclared greedy_coverage. Report all policies/profiles and raw denominators.
protocol.score_ties: Round policy score to 12 decimal places for deterministic ties, then greatest candidate identifier; raw published scores retained.
protocol.search_cache: Success memo only within one goal and fixed portfolio; hit costs one visit. No failure cache or cross-goal/policy proof reuse.
protocol.search_order: Selected exact lemma leaf (ID order), syntactic reflexivity/projections/injections/distributivity; same-root monotonicity; source-union sup_le; target-intersection le_inf; transitivity pivots.
protocol.search_unit: One visited raw-syntax goal state, charged before leaf/cache/cycle checks. Failed branch work is never refunded; an AND second child is visited only after first-child success. Applicable-rule attempts/cache hits/cycle cuts are additionally reported. This is not a Lean heartbeat or tactic-step unit.
protocol.seed: Mathlib inf_sup_left; concrete Set Nat, union/intersection

shared_features.cost_fields: candidate_feature_calls counts base feature vectors; conditional_feature_calls counts additional selected-prefix updates; model_prediction_calls counts every prediction, including initial and dynamic calls. selection_trace retains chosen score and prefix per round; candidate score_stage/score_portfolio identify the latest score context, not one common static ranking.
shared_features.menu: Same capped raw AND/OR obligation graph for all learned and goal-aware heuristics; no entailment or actual search probes in selection. Extra feature visits, estimator visits/calls and selection wall time are reported.
shared_features.preprocessing_cache: At most32 raw goal/intermediate-syntax graphs cached, with independent copies for every caller. Primitive membership and frontier size priors precomputed once per graph; no outcomes cached. obligation_visits is logical inventory work; obligation_build_visits and graph_primitive_preprocess_pairs count actual cache-miss construction/preprocessing, with graph_cache_hits/misses reported. Estimator recursion and all search visits remain individually charged. Request-local object-identity memo stores exact JSON syntax keys only; it cannot survive later caller mutation.

ablations: learned_no_bonus: same conditional full model with uncertainty coefficient zero
structure_only: retrained structural+selected-prefix ensemble, without symbolic/history columns
learned_singleton: fit only empty-prefix rows and rank statically, the original standalone-utility objective
training.history: Successful training baseline proof ASTs, deduplicated by context/goal raw pair/proof hash across B, then actual registered rule/transition frequencies.
training.labels: Training-only portfolio-conditioned marginal solved-goal fraction U(S+c)-U(S) at B4/8/12. For each candidate, one fixed seeded uniform partner portfolio at each size0/1/2/3/4, candidate excluded, same partners across B; deduplicate saturated small pools. Include zero/negative labels, feature conditioned on B and selected prefix. No utility-adaptive partner choices or test probes.
training.prospective_design_reason: Before any corpus outcomes, objective review found singleton labels mismatched multi-premise portfolios. Conditioning and a singleton ablation were prospectively fixed, not chosen after a test result.
training.validation: Learned, greedy_coverage and branching_aware at fixed k3/B8, sanity report only; no hyperparameter sweep or test-dependent choice.

protocol.verification: Independently kernel-check seed/candidate proofs and every distinct successful bounded-search proof across policies/profiles. Failed searches have no theorem. Full retained test workload also receives separate pointwise-unfolded Mathlib aesop control without discovered candidates; resource regimes differ.
